name: duopore-public-product-image-url-audit
description: Spot common problems in product image links before you use them in a listing.

interface.longDescription: Spot common problems in product image links before you use them in a listing. Paste the image web addresses you want to check. Find unsupported link types and unusual endings that need review. It checks the link text only. It does not open images, test whether a link works, or check image rights. Some valid image links have no file ending.
defaultPrompt: Check these product image links for common format problems.
Which image URLs need me to take a closer look?

positive.prompt: Use Product Image URL Audit with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"images":[{"sku":"001","url":"https://images.example.com/item.jpg"},{"sku":"002","url":"ftp://images.example.com/item.png"}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"1 image references need format review.","rows":[{"sku":"001","url":"https://images.example.com/item.jpg","status":"format passes","protocol":"https","issues":""},{"sku":"002","url":"ftp://images.example.com/item.png","status":"review","protocol":"ftp","issues":"use HTTP or HTTPS"}],"warnings":["No fetching, reachability, image-content, security or rights verification.","Extension checks may flag valid image transformation URLs."]}
